ambiguities.description: It's unclear whether 'maximum capacity' is a mandatory attribute for every offering or merely commonly tracked; the transcript states each offering 'has' a maximum capacity, but no explicit 'must' language is used, unlike other exactly-one statements.

ambiguities.description: The final exchange about grades states a student receives a grade 'for each course offering they were enrolled in,' implying grading is tied to enrollment, but it doesn't clarify whether every enrolled student is guaranteed to eventually receive a grade (i.e., is the grade mandatory upon enrollment, or optional until the semester ends) -- the phrase 'at the end of a semester' suggests a timing dependency that isn't fully modeled as a constraint.

ambiguities.description: It is not explicitly stated whether the combination of Course and Semester uniquely determines a Course Offering (i.e., whether a course can have only one offering per semester) -- the example 'Intro to Databases might run in both Fall and Spring' shows offerings across different semesters, but doesn't clarify if multiple offerings of the same course within the same semester are possible.
